lines.trans: Brother Kaiwen, already locked in the schedule over there, okay. Just raised so many demands.
Xin Huimei is coming on the show.
Li Mingji's matter is handed over to me.

meanings.note: Particle le marking completion after a verb or a new situation at the end of a sentence.

examples.trans: I want to tell you one thing.
She did not know about Wang Er's affair.
That hand over to is good.

meanings.note: Sentence-final particle a adding warmth or urgency.
Warm spoken counterpart of 很多 (hǎoduō).

examples.trans: There is so much work at the company.

meanings.note: Adverb yǐjīng, usually paired with final 了.

examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!
Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!
Coming — I will pay the bill!

meanings.note: Structural particle de linking modifiers to nouns.

examples.trans: Do you want this job or not?
Wang Er has to take responsibility.
